name: Speechbox Chat
author: speechbox

sections.description:
Speechbox Chat connects your WordPress site to the Speechbox hosted chat service at speechbox.chat. After connecting or creating a Speechbox account, the plugin adds your selected Speechbox to your site as a popup button or as an inline chat using the [speechbox] shortcode.

Speechbox is a hosted Software as a Service product. A free Speechbox can be used with the included free features. Optional paid Speechbox subscriptions unlock additional hosted service features.

Speechbox is an independent service built and operated by Tim Teege in Hamburg, Germany.

What the plugin does

  • Creates or connects a Speechbox account from the WordPress settings page.
  • Adds the Speechbox widget script to your WordPress site.
  • Lets you choose one of the Speechboxes where your connected account has admin access.
  • Supports popup display or inline display with the [speechbox] shortcode.
  • Lets you configure width, height, initial popup state, and optional WordPress user nickname prefilling.
  • Shows the current Speechbox Premium status for the selected box.

External service

This plugin connects to the Speechbox service at https://www.speechbox.chat/.

During setup, the plugin sends your email address, password, WordPress site URL, WordPress locale, and plugin version to Speechbox so an account and chatbox can be created or connected. The password is used only for the Speechbox account connection request and is not stored by this WordPress plugin.

After setup, the plugin loads the Speechbox widget script from https://www.speechbox.chat/widget.js on public pages where the chatbox is active. Visitors who use the chatbox communicate with the Speechbox hosted service. If nickname prefilling is enabled, the display name or username of logged-in WordPress users may be passed to the widget as a nickname.

Terms: https://www.speechbox.chat/terms
Privacy policy: https://www.speechbox.chat/privacy

The plugin also adds suggested text to the WordPress privacy policy guide under Settings > Privacy.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install it from the WordPress plugin screen.
  2. Activate Speechbox Chat.
  3. Go to Settings > Speechbox Chat.
  4. Enter your email address and a password to create or connect your Speechbox account.
  5. Confirm your email address if asked.
  6. Choose how the chat should appear on your site.
sections.faq:
Do I need a Speechbox account?

Yes. The plugin creates or connects a Speechbox account because the chat service is hosted by Speechbox.

Can I use Speechbox for free?

Yes. Speechbox has free functionality. Paid subscriptions are optional and unlock additional hosted service features.

Where do I change colors and detailed chatbox settings?

Open the Speechbox dashboard from the plugin settings page. The dashboard contains the full Speechbox design and behavior settings.

Can I place the chatbox inside a page or post?

Yes. Set the display mode to inline and place the [speechbox] shortcode where you want the chatbox to appear.

What happens when I uninstall the plugin?

The plugin removes its local WordPress settings. Your Speechbox account and hosted Speechboxes are not deleted.
